name: describe
description: Show a test program's profiles (nodes, sources, faults) and scenarios (test commands).

name: explore
description: Explore a scenario: snapshot after setup, run many branches (each a different interleaving, faults and inputs), and report which properties failed and in which branches.

name: replay
description: Replay one branch exactly; optionally stop at a virtual time and run a shell command in the guest there (e.g. det-nodes exec <node> <command>). With continue, the branch runs on after the command, so a change made there (data, configuration, code through a REPL) plays out.

continue.description: After exec, let the branch run to its end (see the effects of the change)

name: fork
description: Replay a branch to a virtual time, snapshot it there, and explore new branches from that moment.

exec.description: A command to run at the fork point first: the branches explore the changed system
